selection_independence: PROCEDURAL, NOT EMPIRICAL. The 960-title candidate list was frozen in corpus/scale/distractor_candidates.json before any fetch and before any question construction, with seed 'scale-v1', and its method string declares it independent of benchmark answers. No scale title was chosen by looking at a held-out answer, and no scale article is evidence-bearing. This is a procedural guarantee about a curated list; it is not a statistical independence test.
